description: One-domain report: runs the OrionCMD site audit (TLS from CT logs, DNS/DNSSEC/CAA, RDAP expiry, SPF/DMARC/DKIM/MTA-STS, security headers, security.txt) and the AEO Inspector deep scan (AI crawler access, bot-vs-browser diff, agent-ready checks) for one domain. Returns both grades and one merged, priority-sorted fixes list (paste-ready DNS records, registrar steps, robots.txt/llms.txt/JSON-LD) with a shell command to verify each, plus a report_url kept 30 days. Not charged if any part can't run. Costs $2 USDC per call via x402 (payment in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or a failed run returns an error and is not charged.
